item.title: Why Chrome Videos Go Black in ScreenCaptureKit Recordings When Switching macOS Spaces
item.description: Why did Chrome window recording work across macOS Spaces, then start showing black video? A forgotten launch flag, Pulse comparisons, Chromium source, and a media trace reveal suppressed video submission while decoding continues.

item.title: Why Safari Videos Go Black in ScreenCaptureKit Recordings When Switching macOS Spaces
item.description: Why does Safari video turn black in a Mac window recording after switching Spaces? Local video tests, OBS comparisons, Canvas experiments, WebKit source, and runtime logs reveal the visibility policy behind it.
